jobs.title: Director, Design
jobs.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

Your Impact

As Director, Design, you will lead and evolve the organization’s design function, delivering high-quality, client-centric creative experiences that strengthen the brand and support business and marketing objectives. Reporting to the VP, Creative & Brand, you will lead a multidisciplinary team while shaping the future of the design organization through talent development, creative innovation, operational excellence, and AI-enabled transformation.

You Will

Lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team of designers, fostering creativity, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
Translate brand and creative strategy into scalable, high-quality design solutions across digital, omnichannel, and marketing experiences.
Coach and develop designers across all levels, establishing career pathways, development plans, and future leadership opportunities.
Shape the future design workforce by identifying capability gaps and developing skills across emerging disciplines such as creative strategy, content design, design specialization, and AI-enabled creative production.
Lead the adoption of AI-powered tools and workflows to improve creative productivity, scalability, automation, and effectiveness while maintaining brand and quality standards.
Oversee creative operations, including resource allocation, capacity planning, prioritization, workflow optimization, and project delivery.
Partner with Marketing, Communications, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, and other stakeholders to translate business priorities into effective creative strategies.
Serve as a strategic partner to the VP, Creative & Brand on workforce planning, organizational capability, technology adoption, and creative operations.
Champion brand stewardship and governance through design systems, templates, component libraries, and scalable creative standards.
Drive innovation and continuous improvement while ensuring the design organization remains agile and prepared for evolving business, technology, and marketing demands.

What The Role Offers

The opportunity to shape the future of a global design organization and influence how creative work evolves.
The ability to build and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary design team and future creative leaders.
An opportunity to lead the adoption of AI and emerging technologies across creative workflows and production.
The opportunity to influence workforce strategy, career pathways, organizational capabilities, and the future skills of the design function.
A highly strategic role partnering with senior leadership and cross-functional teams across Marketing and the broader organization.
The opportunity to balance creative excellence with operational efficiency, scalability, innovation, and measurable business impact.
The ability to modernize design practices, processes, tools, and technologies to meet the changing needs of modern marketing.

What You Need to Succeed

15+ years of progressive experience in design, creative services, brand marketing, or a related field, including 10+ years leading creative teams.
Proven experience leading diverse, multidisciplinary teams and developing talent across varying levels of experience and specialization.
A strong track record of building high-performing teams, developing future leaders, and evolving organizational capabilities.
Experience leading teams through change, transformation, or operating model evolution within a corporate marketing, agency, or internal creative environment.
Strong creative judgment and expertise in design principles, visual communication, storytelling, brand systems, and creative strategy.
Demonstrated experience with creative operations, including workflow management, resource planning, capacity management, and process optimization.
Strong strategic thinking, business acumen, workforce planning, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
Experience implementing AI-powered creative tools, workflow optimization, automation, or creative enablement technologies.
Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud and familiarity with modern design, collaboration, project management, and resource planning platforms.
Strong understanding of generative AI, prompt design, automation, and emerging creative technologies.
Exceptional communication, presentation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities.
A passion for developing people, embracing innovation, and preparing design organizations for the future.

OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

Compensation:
At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. A summary of those benefits can be found on our Why Join Us page. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.

Salary Range:
Depending on the candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market, actual salary may vary and be higher or lower than the range posted.

California Residents:
The pay range above is a reasonable estimate of salary based on pay scale, candidate experience, skills, and education. In addition to the comprehensive benefits noted above, the role may be eligible for bonus or commissions.

AI Usage Disclosure:
As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.

jobs.title: Software Alliances Director, Americas
jobs.description:
The Software Alliances team at Canonical works with leading software companies to optimize and enable their products with Ubuntu and other Canonical software, for instance our AI offerings. We develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, and formulate go-to-market plans, content and processes, enabling differentiated offerings and robust product life-cycle support anchored to best-in-class Canonical products. Enterprises are able to receive the benefits of open source, securely maintained, and validated solutions from cloud to edge, whether purchased from Canonical, embedded in Alliance partners’ products, or accessed through the cloud.

The successful candidate is someone who has demonstrated success in business development or product management, both as a leader and an individual contributor in major accounts. If you are someone who is passionate about open source, can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you. This role is ideal for professionals with 7+ years of experience.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas region.

The role entails

Setting the account strategy in a major account, region, and/or vertical.
Collaborating with product, engineering, alliance and marketing teams at partners to align on open-source strategies.
Capturing partner requirements, evaluating gaps, and identifying Canonical opportunities.
Coordinating with marketing and product teams on messaging, content creation, and launch plans.
Creating partner- and customer-facing materials like reference architectures, joint blueprints, webinars, presentations, videos, and white papers.
Driving Ubuntu adoption within targeted alliance accounts, advocating its benefits to stakeholders and working with partners on enablement training for their development, delivery, support and commercial teams.
Influencing alliance partners to build with Canonical technology.
Up to 25% travel, including internationally, for internal conferences and to drive partnerships in person.

What we are looking for in you

Demonstrated cross-functional leadership and influence
Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
Bachelor's degree in science, technology and/or engineering.
Experience in software development and system architecture.
Customer-facing experience in software engineering, product management, business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
Excellent communication skills across all levels of stakeholders - individual contributors to the C-suite; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels.
Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.

Nice-to-have Skills And Experience

Experience with open source software and open source business models.
Product management or program management experience.
Understanding of marketing and go-to-market strategy.
Sector-specific experience in finance, telecommunications, automotive, or public sectors.
Working knowledge of independent hardware and software vendor go-to-market motions.
Post-graduate degree in science, technology or engineering field.

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Commercial Strategy & Partnerships
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Work Arrangement:
This is a hybrid position requiring candidates to work on-site at least 2 days per week at our office in Mississauga. The remaining days may be worked remotely, subject to team and business needs.

About the Role (Job Summary):

McKesson Canada is seeking a strategic and results-oriented Sr. Director, Commercial Strategy & Partnerships to lead revenue growth, new client acquisition, and strategic partnerships across our Specialty Health portfolio.

Reporting into senior leadership, you will lead a high-performing business development team responsible for expanding market share, identifying new commercial opportunities, and strengthening relationships across the healthcare ecosystem. This role combines strategic leadership, sales execution, and cross-functional collaboration to drive sustainable growth and reinforce McKesson's position as a leader in specialty healthcare solutions.

What You'll Do (Responsibilities):

Develop and execute the Specialty Health business development and sales strategy to achieve revenue growth and market expansion objectives.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of business development professionals, establishing clear goals, performance expectations, and development plans.
Own the Specialty Health business development budget, sales forecast, and pipeline performance.
Drive new business growth by identifying, evaluating, and securing strategic partnerships and customer opportunities.
Support and coach team members in customer meetings, solution development, presentations, and negotiations.
Monitor pipeline health, sales performance, forecasting accuracy, and customer engagement metrics.
Develop business cases, financial models, and commercial proposals to support growth opportunities.
Analyze healthcare market trends, competitive intelligence, and customer insights to inform strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with Marketing, Operations, Finance, Product, and other cross-functional partners to deliver customer-focused solutions.
Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key customers, partners, and industry stakeholders.
Ensure excellence in customer interactions, proposal development, and executive presentations.
Leverage internal subject matter experts to deliver innovative solutions that drive customer and business outcomes.

Basic Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
15+ years of demonstrated success in sales and/or marketing, with a consistent track record of achieving and exceeding business objectives within the healthcare industry.
Experience within the pharmaceutical industry (brand, generic, or biosimilar) or within the Specialty space.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales, revenue, and growth objectives.
Demonstrated success developing and executing strategic business development plans.
Experience managing complex sales cycles and enterprise-level customer relationships.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working within matrixed organizations and leading cross-functional initiatives.
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior healthcare leaders and decision-makers.
Expertise in contract negotiations and strategic partnership development.

Preferred Skills/Experience:

Experience leading large, geographically dispersed, high-performing sales teams.
Strong financial acumen, including forecasting, budgeting, business case development, and ROI analysis.

The expected base salary range for this role is $190,000–$215,000, with final compensation determined based on experience, qualifications, and skills.

We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, please click here.

Our Base Pay Range for this position

$151,200 - $201,600

jobs.title: Associate Director, Strategic Pursuits, Managed Services
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

We are seeking a highly motivated, strategic, and commercially focused leader to join EY Canada's Strategic Deals Team (SDT) within Clients & Industries as an Associate Director, Managed Services Growth & Strategic Pursuits.

In this role, you will help drive the growth of EY's Managed Services business by leading strategic pursuits, supporting opportunity conversion, and identifying opportunities to expand existing client relationships. You will work closely with Managed Services leaders, client-serving professionals, Service Delivery Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to support the pursuit lifecycle, enhance opportunity quality, and contribute to the continued growth of the Managed Services portfolio.

As a key member of the team, you will help shape and execute growth strategies, support major business development opportunities, review strategic managed services pursuits, and coach teams on identifying and capturing additional revenue opportunities within existing accounts. This role offers significant exposure to senior leadership and high-profile opportunities across sectors, service lines, and managed services offerings.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead and support strategic Managed Services pursuits and business development opportunities across sectors and service offerings
Drive the pursuit lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, solution development, proposal support, client presentations, negotiations, and contract execution.
Partner with account teams and client-serving professionals to identify, shape, and advance Managed Services opportunities.
Review and provide quality oversight on active managed services pursuits to improve win rates, enhance delivery readiness, and support successful outcomes.
Support the review and management of existing managed services engagements to ensure delivery commitments are being achieved and growth opportunities are identified.
Coach and support Service Delivery Managers in identifying, developing, and closing upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing client accounts.
Contribute to the development and execution of managed services growth strategies and account expansion plans.
Monitor and report on pursuit activity, pipeline performance, opportunity progression, and key growth metrics.
Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across Managed Services, Clients & Industries, service lines, Risk Management, Finance, and other support functions.
Facilitate pursuit discussions, opportunity reviews, and stakeholder meetings to drive alignment and decision-making.
Manage multiple strategic opportunities and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Contribute to team, practice, and firm initiatives as part of continuous improvement objectives.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Strong business development, sales, and relationship management capabilities.
Proven ability to lead complex pursuits, strategic opportunities, and growth initiatives.
Strong project management skills with the ability to establish priorities, manage multiple deadlines, and navigate competing demands.
Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess opportunities, risks, and business outcomes.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior leaders and client-serving teams.
Sound judgment and professionalism when handling sensitive and confidential information.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment while maintaining high-quality deliverables

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in a related discipline.
Approximately 10+ years of progressive experience in managed services, business development, account management, strategic pursuits, consulting, or related disciplines.
Proven experience leading complex pursuits, large opportunities, or strategic growth initiatives.
Demonstrated success in developing and expanding client relationships and driving revenue growth.
Experience reviewing and shaping strategic opportunities from qualification through deal execution.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work across multiple service lines and business functions.
Experience presenting to executive-level stakeholders and influencing decision-makers.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Ability to work independently and effectively navigate a complex, matrixed organization.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience within a professional services environment.
ITIL certification.
Bilingualism in English and French would be considered an asset

What We Offer

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

EY reports salary ranges in accordance with applicable provincial pay transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.

Vancouver/Victoria: $126,800 to $211,300
Dieppe: $114,000 to $190,000

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

At EY, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as one element of our recruitment process to enhance efficiency and improve the candidate experience. While AI supports us in our process, human judgment and decision-making remain integral in our candidate experience. We are committed to the responsible use of AI, and our practices are continuously reviewed and refined to ensure they align with ethical principles and regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: LoanIQ - VP, Business Analysis
jobs.description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst with strong LoanIQ (LIQ), ACBS and/or other core lending platform expertise and Vice President-level experience in lending operations, product, change delivery, or business transformation. This role will be responsible for driving business analysis, target operating model design, requirements management, migration support, and cross-functional delivery for LoanIQ, ACBS, legacy loans platform and other loans – peripheral systems related initiatives across agency, syndicated, and commercial lending products.

The ideal candidate will bring deep knowledge of the end-to-end lending lifecycle, strong stakeholder management skills, and hands-on experience translating business needs into clear functional requirements for technology and operations teams. This individual will operate at a senior level, partnering closely with Operations, Technology, Product, Finance, Risk, front-office stakeholders, vendors, and system integrators to support LoanIQ implementation, migration, enhancement, and optimization initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Lead business analysis activities for LoanIQ (LIQ) / ACBS / legacy loans platform initiatives, including implementation, migration, platform enhancement, and operating model transformation.
Partner with business, operations, and technology stakeholders to define current-state processes, identify gaps, and design future-state workflows.
Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements, functional requirements, process flows, and data requirements.
Support development of Target Operating Model (TOM) deliverables, including process design, roles and responsibilities, control points, and business capability mapping.
Act as a key liaison between business users, operations teams, technology teams, vendors, and front-office stakeholders to ensure requirements are understood and delivered accurately.
Spearhead analysis supporting the decommissioning of legacy loan platforms, including data mapping, migration, reconciliation, and cutover readiness activities.
Identify, document, and prioritize continuous system enhancements to optimize LoanIQ capabilities and address complex lending requirements.
Partner directly with external vendors and system integrators to ensure deliverables align with internal project milestones and business expectations.
Support solution design discussions and help assess upstream/downstream impacts, integrations, and operational dependencies.
Drive workshops with stakeholders across lending operations, agency services, servicing, finance, accounting, settlements, and risk/control functions.
Translate business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and testing scenarios for development and QA teams.
Support UAT planning and execution, including test case review, defect triage, business validation, and go-live readiness.
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes across the lending lifecycle, reducing operational risk and improving service delivery.
Provide and lead business support activities for LIQ, ACBS, legacy loans platform and other peripheral systems, as needed.
Assist in issue management, risk tracking, dependency management, and status reporting for senior governance forums.
Lead and mentor junior analysts within the workstream, providing guidance on LoanIQ functionality and project delivery best practices.
Deliver executive-level presentations and updates to senior leadership, including project milestones, risks, and key achievements.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Technology, or related field.
10+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Operations Change, or Project Management within Corporate / Investment Banking.
Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience with Finastra LoanIQ, ACBS and/or other core Lending platforms
VP-level experience in Business Analysis, Lending Operations, Product, Change Management, or related banking functions.
Strong hands-on experience with LIQ, ACBS or other core lending platform in a business, operational, product, or change capacity.
Deep understanding of commercial lending, including syndicated loans, bilateral loans, agency servicing, trading, and secondary loan markets.
Proven experience supporting or leading large-scale system implementations, particularly migration from legacy platforms to vendor solutions.
Strong experience writing business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, process maps, gap analyses, and UAT documentation.
Strong knowledge of the end-to-end loan lifecycle, including origination, servicing, rollover, rate setting, fee processing, payments, notices, and settlements.
Strong stakeholder management experience with the ability to engage senior leaders, business users, and technology teams effectively.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Experience defining creative solutions to meet business needs.
Experience in creating training plans and training materials and in training Operations on functionalities developed by IT.

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of hands-on experience with LoanIQ, FIS ACBS and/or legacy Loans platforms
Experience in Target Operating Model design and business process re-engineering.
Knowledge of agent bank operations, lender servicing, primary/secondary loan trading, and fee processing.
Experience with data mapping, conversion, interfaces, and reconciliations between LoanIQ and surrounding applications.
Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
Exposure to tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Visio, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Experience working with global teams across Operations, Technology, Product, and Change.
Knowledge of control, audit, risk, and regulatory considerations in lending operations.
Knowledge of various application functionalities that translate across products.
Ability to identify and assess near-term business needs and advise business and technology on options and benefits.

Core Skills

LoanIQ / LIQ subject matter expertise
Business analysis and requirements gathering
Process mapping and gap analysis
Lending operations knowledge
Legacy platform migration support
Data mapping and reconciliation
Stakeholder and workstream leadership
UAT and testing support
Process improvement and automation
Executive communication and presentation skills

What Success Looks Like

Requirements are captured clearly and translated into actionable deliverables for technology and operations teams.
Legacy platform migration activities are supported effectively, with strong focus on data mapping, reconciliation, and operational readiness.
Future-state processes are well designed, controlled, and aligned to business objectives.
Stakeholders across business, operations, technology, and vendors remain aligned throughout the delivery lifecycle.
LoanIQ/ACBS/Legacy loans platform/other Peripheral system solutions are implemented or enhanced with strong operational readiness and minimal disruption.
Risks, issues, and dependencies are proactively identified and managed.

The typical base pay range for this role is between $176K - $215K depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. This role may also be eligible for certain discretionary performance-based bonuses and/or incentive compensation. Additionally, our Total Rewards program provides colleagues with a competitive benefits package (in accordance with the eligibility requirements and respective terms of each) that includes comprehensive health and wellness benefits, retirement plans, educational assistance and training programs, income replacement for qualified employees with disabilities, paid maternity and parental bonding leave, and paid vacation, sick days, and holidays. jobs.title: Associate Director, Real World Data Science
jobs.description:
At AstraZeneca, we pride ourselves on crafting a collaborative culture that champions knowledge-sharing, ambitious thinking and innovation – ultimately providing employees with the opportunity to work across teams, functions and even the globe.

Recognizing the importance of individualized flexibility, our ways of working allow employees to balance personal and work commitments while ensuring we continue to build a strong culture of collaboration and teamwork by engaging face-to-face in our offices 3 days a week.

Our dedication to sustainability is also central to our culture and part of what makes AstraZeneca a great place to work. We know the health of people, the planet and our business are interconnected which is why we’re taking ambitious action to address some of the biggest challenges of our time, from climate change to access to healthcare and disease prevention.Reporting to the Senior Director, RWD Science, the role will collaborate with epidemiology, statistics, health economics, pharmacovigilance, and medical evidence teams to design and deliver observational studies and advanced analyses that support therapeutic-area strategies, product development, and business decision-making. The role has a global remit and is based within AstraZeneca’s global geographical footprint.

Key Responsibilities

RWD analysis and delivery: Deliver and implement secondary data analyses using electronic health records, insurance claims, registries, and other observational data to address therapeutic-area evidence needs
Scientific and technical leadership: Provide expert guidance on observational study design, data-source selection, data-partner evaluation, statistical analysis plans, and best practices in RWD utilization.
Assess the strengths, limitations, capabilities, and suitability of external RWD sources
Cross-functional collaboration: Work with epidemiologists, statisticians, health economists, medical teams, and other stakeholders throughout the study execution.
Mentor and coach data scientists and contribute to technical education, knowledge sharing, communities of practice, and continuous improvement across the RWDS organization.
Maintain awareness of developments in RWD, causal inference, healthcare analytics, data standards, AI, and emerging analytical platforms, and assess their practical relevance to AZ evidence generation through external partnerships.
Translate complex analytical findings, data limitations, and methodological trade-offs into clear insights and options for scientific and business partners.
Lead or contribute to structured data feasibility and fit-for-purpose assessments that make data availability, quality, completeness, follow-up, endpoint capture, confounding, and key trade-offs visible to study teams.
Apply and advance appropriate statistical, epidemiological, machine-learning, and data-science methods for healthcare research, with methods selected according to the scientific question and data context.
Develop, use, review, and promote standardized and reusable analytical assets, including code, code lists, functions, templates, documentation, and quality-control approaches, to improve consistency and reproducibility.
Use artificial intelligence and automation as decision-support and productivity capabilities with appropriate human oversight, validation, documentation, and protection of patient-level data.

Essential Qualifications And Experience

Advanced degree: PhD or MSc in statistics, mathematics, data science, or a life-sciences discipline, combined with relevant industry experience.
RWE expertise: Proven experience delivering real-world evidence or observational research, with familiarity in epidemiology, health economics, health-outcomes modelling, or related quantitative disciplines.
Healthcare data: Hands-on experience working with EMR/EHR, disease-registry, and/or insurance-claims databases.
Data standards: Knowledge of clinical data standards, medical terminologies, controlled vocabularies, and healthcare ontologies, including ICD-9/10 and SNOMED.
Study delivery: Experience supporting pharmacoepidemiology studies, including the development and execution of Statistical Analysis Plans.
Programming: Proficiency in SQL and R and/or Python.
Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary data-science projects and translate scientific and business needs into actionable RWD programmes.

Desirable Experience

Experience in advanced visualization and visual analytics of healthcare data, applying RWD to pharmacovigilance, delivering solutions in a global organization, and developing long-term stakeholder and external-partner relationships.

new_jobs.title: Associate Director, Real World Data Science
new_jobs.description:
At AstraZeneca, we pride ourselves on crafting a collaborative culture that champions knowledge-sharing, ambitious thinking and innovation – ultimately providing employees with the opportunity to work across teams, functions and even the globe.

Recognizing the importance of individualized flexibility, our ways of working allow employees to balance personal and work commitments while ensuring we continue to build a strong culture of collaboration and teamwork by engaging face-to-face in our offices 3 days a week.

Our dedication to sustainability is also central to our culture and part of what makes AstraZeneca a great place to work. We know the health of people, the planet and our business are interconnected which is why we’re taking ambitious action to address some of the biggest challenges of our time, from climate change to access to healthcare and disease prevention.Reporting to the Senior Director, RWD Science, the role will collaborate with epidemiology, statistics, health economics, pharmacovigilance, and medical evidence teams to design and deliver observational studies and advanced analyses that support therapeutic-area strategies, product development, and business decision-making. The role has a global remit and is based within AstraZeneca’s global geographical footprint.

Key Responsibilities

RWD analysis and delivery: Deliver and implement secondary data analyses using electronic health records, insurance claims, registries, and other observational data to address therapeutic-area evidence needs
Scientific and technical leadership: Provide expert guidance on observational study design, data-source selection, data-partner evaluation, statistical analysis plans, and best practices in RWD utilization.
Assess the strengths, limitations, capabilities, and suitability of external RWD sources
Cross-functional collaboration: Work with epidemiologists, statisticians, health economists, medical teams, and other stakeholders throughout the study execution.
Mentor and coach data scientists and contribute to technical education, knowledge sharing, communities of practice, and continuous improvement across the RWDS organization.
Maintain awareness of developments in RWD, causal inference, healthcare analytics, data standards, AI, and emerging analytical platforms, and assess their practical relevance to AZ evidence generation through external partnerships.
Translate complex analytical findings, data limitations, and methodological trade-offs into clear insights and options for scientific and business partners.
Lead or contribute to structured data feasibility and fit-for-purpose assessments that make data availability, quality, completeness, follow-up, endpoint capture, confounding, and key trade-offs visible to study teams.
Apply and advance appropriate statistical, epidemiological, machine-learning, and data-science methods for healthcare research, with methods selected according to the scientific question and data context.
Develop, use, review, and promote standardized and reusable analytical assets, including code, code lists, functions, templates, documentation, and quality-control approaches, to improve consistency and reproducibility.
Use artificial intelligence and automation as decision-support and productivity capabilities with appropriate human oversight, validation, documentation, and protection of patient-level data.

Essential Qualifications And Experience

Advanced degree: PhD or MSc in statistics, mathematics, data science, or a life-sciences discipline, combined with relevant industry experience.
RWE expertise: Proven experience delivering real-world evidence or observational research, with familiarity in epidemiology, health economics, health-outcomes modelling, or related quantitative disciplines.
Healthcare data: Hands-on experience working with EMR/EHR, disease-registry, and/or insurance-claims databases.
Data standards: Knowledge of clinical data standards, medical terminologies, controlled vocabularies, and healthcare ontologies, including ICD-9/10 and SNOMED.
Study delivery: Experience supporting pharmacoepidemiology studies, including the development and execution of Statistical Analysis Plans.
Programming: Proficiency in SQL and R and/or Python.
Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary data-science projects and translate scientific and business needs into actionable RWD programmes.

Desirable Experience

Experience in advanced visualization and visual analytics of healthcare data, applying RWD to pharmacovigilance, delivering solutions in a global organization, and developing long-term stakeholder and external-partner relationships.
